phases.name: Groundwork
phases.window: Until a public reveal, or more than 52 weeks out
phases.focus: Your hook, your player, comparable games, tags, store accounts, home base.

phases.name: Reveal
phases.window: When the store page goes public, ideally 9 to 12 months out (guideline)
phases.focus: Coming Soon page, art to spec, first trailer, simple website, press kit, tracking links.

phases.name: Grow
phases.focus: A steady content rhythm, playtests, creator and curator list, themed events that fit.

phases.name: Showcase
phases.window: Around your chosen festival, usually 20 to 8 weeks out
phases.focus: Demo, festival checklist and dates, demo notice to wishlisters.

phases.name: Final approach
phases.focus: Store page final pass, build review, date lock, launch discount, keys, outreach, launch trailer, run sheet.

phases.name: Launch window
phases.window: 7 days before to 7 days after launch
phases.focus: Daily mode: run sheet, announcements, replies, fixes.

phases.name: First month
phases.focus: Reviews, updates, 30-day discount rule, first seasonal sale.

phases.name: Long tail
phases.focus: Sales and events, updates, a gentle discount ladder, next project.

sprint_rule: Phases 2 to 5 merge into one Sprint. Keep gates and priority 1 tasks; lower priority tasks that are already late are skipped by the plan, not by the owner.

working_date_rules.month: the 15th, moved to the next weekday if it falls on a weekend
working_date_rules.quarter: the 15th of the middle month, moved to the next weekday if needed
